title: Arrange-Act-Assert
description: Structure your tests with the AAA pattern.

data.text: **Arrange-Act-Assert (AAA)** is a pattern for organizing unit tests. It separates the test into three clear sections: setup, execution, and verification.

data.title: AAA Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Arrange: Set up test data and dependencies
Act: Execute the code being tested
data.takeaway: Use AAA pattern to write clear, organized tests.
